content.stem: 以下哪些情况会导致政治公众人物(PEP)比一般高风险银行客户带来更大的风险？(选择两项.)

options.A: 政治公众人物的家庭成员和密切关系人可能会参与非法活动.
options.B: 根据国际银行业规定,政治公众人物可获得无限制的信贷和金融豁免.
options.C: 政治公众人物可能会利用使馆活动来掩盖贿赂和腐败交易.
options.D: 即使资金来源不合法，其账户也不会因超出银行风险承受能力的活动而被合法关闭.

content.stem_en: Which of the following conditions contribute to a politically exposed person (PEP) posing greater risk than a typical high-risk bank customer? (Select two.)

options_en.A: The family members and close associates of PEPs may be involved in illicit activities
options_en.B: PEPs are granted unlimited credit and financial immunity under international banking regulations
options_en.C: PEPs may exploit embassy activities to conceal bribery and corruption transactions
options_en.D: PEPs can have illegitimate fund sources but are legally protected from having their accounts closed for activities outside the bank's risk tolerance
